summary: security checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity: high for fleet-wide go-live, new public exposure, and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: security baseline covers 61 managed sites, but fleet-doctor is not OK and has no run, checks, findings, or site results; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results; and authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance is technical-only with 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown. Exact decision: preserve private-launch and security-sensitive release gates; permit only reversible work that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Missing evidence is not treated as a vulnerability or clean result.

Retain the existing consolidated security evidence matrix; do not create duplicate proposals or telemetry requests. Complete it with dated evidence or explicit unknowns, affected scope, owner, severity, and release implications using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, or conduct external outreach.
